architecture_stack.scraper_architecture: Watchdog Pattern: watchdog.exe monitors/restarts scraper.exe. UTC-synchronized batch execution at 00:00 and 12:00 UTC.
architecture_stack.future_scope: LLM-driven 'Smart Procurement' Agent (Task Decomposition & Optimization) moved to Phase 3 backlog to prevent scope creep.

target_categories: PC Components (Motherboards, CPUs, GPUs, Power Supplies)

bronze_layer_raw_extraction: extra_data (JSON blob for additional retailer-specific fields)

extraction_rules.rate_limiting: HARDCODED randomized delay of 5.0-7.0 seconds between all web requests. Egyptian Anti-Cybercrime Law 175/2018.
extraction_rules.decoupling: Extraction engine is strictly separated from transformation logic to protect ML pipeline from UI changes.

execution_model.watchdog_exe: Lightweight process supervisor. Launches, monitors, and restarts scraper.exe on crash (OOM, unhandled exception). Fires webhook alert on failure. Max 5 restart attempts.
execution_model.scraper_exe: Batch executor. Runs all assigned retailers in one cycle. UTC-synchronized via delta calculation to fixed intervals.
execution_model.sleep_prevention: Windows kernel32 SetThreadExecutionState prevents OS sleep/hibernate while exe is running.

scheduling.method: UTC delta calculation — never naive sleep(43200). Recalculates from scratch after every cycle.
scheduling.catchup: If laptop was asleep and missed an interval, executes immediately on wake.

data_persistence.local_backup: Each cycle creates a new SQLite .db file. Never deleted. Permanent local backup.
data_persistence.cloud_upload: After cycle, appends data to GCP Cloud Storage (Bronze bucket). JSON Lines format, partitioned by retailer.
data_persistence.retry_logic: 3 retries at 1-minute intervals on cloud upload failure.
data_persistence.store_and_forward: Failed uploads buffered locally as .json files. Re-attempted on next cycle.

notifications.method: Native SMTP via smtplib (Gmail App Passwords). No GCP dependencies.
